dedupe_keys.name: chatev language model electric vehicle charging forecasts

description: The ChatEV research team publishes Python code that adapts large language models to electric-vehicle charging-demand forecasting. The repository documents inference, fine-tuning and a Lightning training and evaluation workflow, including a first-order Reptile method for few-shot adaptation. Public implementation code is free under MIT. Coverage is demonstrated through charging-demand series associated with the UrbanEV research, not a universal charging-fleet model. Forecasts can inform charger capacity and grid-demand simulations using data-urbanev-shenzhen-ev-charging and model-pypsa. A caveat is that upstream language-model weights have separate access conditions and licences; public code does not guarantee access to every referenced model. Forecast performance may also change across cities, stations and time periods. Source documentation was checked without retrieving weights, training a model or reproducing benchmark results.
